title: "Community Composition"
output: html_document
editor_options: 
  chunk_output_type: console
---
```{r Load packages}
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(glmmTMB)
library(DHARMa)
library(emmeans)
```

```{r Load Data}
p_mix <- read.csv("pmix.csv")  
```

```{r Model for Cladocopium proportion}
modelxsl = glmmTMB(props ~ treatment*time_point + (1|sample_name),
                 family =beta_family(link = "logit"),
            data=p_mix,
            REML = TRUE)
summary(modelxsl)
simulateResiduals(modelxsl, plot = TRUE)
emmeans::emmeans(modelxsl, ~ treatment|time_point, at=list(time_point = c('S1','S2','S3')), type = 'response') %>%
  pairs()
```

```{r Pairwise Contrasts}
mixed_seq_conts<- emmeans::emmeans(modelxsl, ~ treatment|time_point, at=list(time_point = c('S1','S2','S3')), type = 'response') %>%
  pairs() %>%
  summary(infer = TRUE) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  group_by(time_point) %>%
  #arrange(odds.ratio) %>%
  mutate(contrast = factor(contrast, levels = unique(contrast))) %>%
  mutate(Flag = factor(ifelse(asymp.LCL > 1, 1, ifelse(asymp.UCL < 1, -1, 0)))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = odds.ratio, y = contrast, colour = Flag)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = asymp.LCL, xmax = asymp.UCL)) +
  scale_x_continuous(trans = scales::log2_trans()) +
  scale_colour_manual(breaks = c(-1,0,1), values = c("red", "black", "green")) +
  facet_grid(~time_point)+
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 20, face="bold",hjust=0.5),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 18, face="bold"),
        axis.title.y = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8, face="bold"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14, face="bold"),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 16, face="bold"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 12, face="bold"))+
  labs(title = "Contrasts")
mixed_seq_conts
```

```{r Individual Contrasts}
p_mix$treatment %>% levels()

cMat <- cbind("Dwt vs Dhe" = c(1/2, -1/2, 1/2, -1/2))  

cMata <- cbind("Cwt vs Che" = c(1/2, 1/2, -1/2, -1/2))  

crossprod(cMat)
emmeans::emmeans(modelxsl, ~ treatment|time_point, at=list(time_point = 'S1'), type = 'response') %>%
  contrast(method = list(Treatment = cMat))

crossprod(cMata)
emmeans::emmeans(modelxsl, ~ treatment|time_point, at=list(time_point = 'S1'), type = 'response') %>%
  contrast(method = list(Treatment = cMata))

crossprod(cMat)
emmeans::emmeans(modelxsl, ~ treatment|time_point, at=list(time_point = 'S2'), type = 'response') %>%
  contrast(method = list(Treatment = cMat))

crossprod(cMata)
emmeans::emmeans(modelxsl, ~ treatment|time_point, at=list(time_point = 'S2'), type = 'response') %>%
  contrast(method = list(Treatment = cMata))


crossprod(cMat)
emmeans::emmeans(modelxsl, ~ treatment|time_point, at=list(time_point = 'S3'), type = 'response') %>%
  contrast(method = list(Treatment = cMat))

crossprod(cMata)
emmeans::emmeans(modelxsl, ~ treatment|time_point, at=list(time_point = 'S3'), type = 'response') %>%
  contrast(method = list(Treatment = cMata))
```

```{r Plot model}
prop_c_mixed <-ggeffects::ggeffect(modelxsl, ~ time_point|treatment) %>% plot( line.size = 1.5,
colors = c("#ee8e36","#1f59c5","#82ad0f","#16b4eb"))+ 
   labs(
    x = "Sampling Points",
    y = "Proportion Cladocopium",
    title = "Community Composition")+
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 20, face="bold",hjust=0.5),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 16, face="bold"),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 14, face="bold"),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 16, face="bold"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 12, face="bold"))

prop_c_mixed

# Generate the effect data
prop_c_mixed_data <- ggeffects::ggeffect(modelxsl, terms = c("time_point", "treatment"))

# Plot using ggplot2
library(ggplot2)

ggplot(prop_c_mixed_data, aes(x = x, y = predicted, color = group)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.5) +
  # Add the original data points
  geom_point(data = p_mix, aes(x = time_point, y = props, color = treatment), alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#ee8e36", "#1f59c5", "#82ad0f", "#16b4eb")) +
  facet_wrap(~treatment) +  
  labs(
    x = "Sampling Points",
    y = "Proportion Cladocopium",
    title = "Community Composition"
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold")
  )

# Generate the effect data from the model
prop_c_mixed_data <- ggeffects::ggeffect(modelxsl, terms = c("time_point", "treatment")) |> 
  rename(treatment = 'group')

# Plot using ggplot2
library(ggplot2)

ggplot() +
  # Add the model prediction lines
  geom_point(data = prop_c_mixed_data, aes(x = x, y = predicted, color = treatment), size = 1.5) +
  geom_ribbon(data = prop_c_mixed_data, aes(x = x, ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high, fill = treatment), alpha = 0.2) +
   geom_errorbar(data = prop_c_mixed_data,aes(x=x,ymin=conf.low,ymax=conf.high,color=treatment,width=0.2))+
  # Add the original data points as an overlay
  geom_point(data = p_mix, aes(x = time_point, y = props), alpha = 0.3) +
  # Customize color scale and facets
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#ee8e36", "#1f59c5", "#82ad0f", "#16b4eb")) +
  facet_wrap(~treatment) +
  # Labels and theme settings
  labs(
    x = "Sampling Points",
    y = "Proportion Cladocopium",
    title = "Community Composition"
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold")
  )+
  theme_bw()
```
